major_concerns: Simulator/digital‑twin fidelity may not reflect production leading to construct‑validity gaps.
Retriever corpus quality may dominate measured RAG benefit (confounding).
Formal verifier false negatives could bias efficacy estimates upward.
LLM nondeterminism and API limits may inflate variance if not tightly controlled.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact public topology sources and CLI emulation toolchain (images, versions) and publish hashes.
Prespecify retriever architecture, embedding model, index params, and retrieval seeds.
Select and justify a concrete verifier implementation (Batfish/NetKAT variant) and document modeling assumptions and limitations.
Provide explicit labeling/threshold rules for actionable misconfiguration and adjudication procedure for simulator/verifier disagreements.
Prespecify exact LLM model identifiers, temperature/decoding settings, retry policy, and random seeds for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Ethical risk from publishing poisoned documents (dual‑use) and potential to enable attacks.
Realism of crafted poison payloads may be limited; transferability to diverse retrievers uncertain.
Mitigations may trade off utility in ways that confound interpretation (overfiltering).
required_design_repairs: Add an explicit ethics/safety protocol and controlled‑release/redaction plan for poisoned corpora and attack artifacts.
Define realistic attacker capability model and justify poison-generation templates with pilot realism tests.
Prespecify retriever/model variants and sensitivity analyses to demonstrate transferability rather than a single‑system result.
Define concrete mitigation implementations (provenance filters, attestation) with parameter ranges and an evaluation rubric for utility vs security tradeoffs.

major_concerns: Mapping high‑level semantic policies into verifier‑checkable properties may require manual templating, undermining full automation claims.
Verifier modeling mismatch with vendor CLI semantics could produce false passes/fails.
Repair prompts may induce oscillation (config churn) rather than converge.
required_design_repairs: Specify the automated policy→verifier translation method and any manual templates required (and how manual steps are logged).
Document vendor‑CLI mapping approach and provide tests showing fidelity for each vendor included.
Include safeguards in repair loop (e.g., change-size limits, edit-distance constraints) and prespecify oscillation-detection and termination criteria.
Plan to measure and report verifier soundness relative to simulator ground truth (false‑positive/negative rates) with preplanned adjudication rules.

major_concerns: Benchmark design risks encoding biases favoring certain pipelines or retrievers.
Public release may enable overfitting/gaming if partitioning and evaluation protocol are insufficient.
Some metrics (trace‑fidelity, canary scoring) require careful, reproducible definitions to avoid ambiguous scoring.
required_design_repairs: Provide explicit task sourcing (public incidents/topology datasets) and justify selection criteria.
Define formal metric formulas (trace‑fidelity, rollback‑safety, canary‑score) with thresholds and example computations.
Prespecify dataset partitioning, evaluation protocol, and anti‑overfitting safeguards (held‑out tasks, challenge split).
Document licensing and safe‑release policy for benchmark artifacts and include reproducibility checksums and example runs.
